newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane mixed, following stock draw.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane mixed, following stock draw.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were mixed in late trade on Wednesday following the release of government stock data showing a 1.2 million draw, players said.
The Energy Information Administration report released late Wednesday said stocks were at 46.4 million barrels as of Nov. 22.
Regionally, the U.S. Gulf Coast rose by 100,000 barrels in the week and the Midwest fell by 200,000 barrels, the EIA said.
Both hubs continued to trail slightly below the normal range for this time of year.
In Conway, Kansas, hub spot propane rose about 2.50 cents following the report. It was ranged between 83.00 cents and 83.25 cents a gallon.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane prices were largely notional given the lack of traders available ahead of the long holiday weekend.
NYMEX is closed Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
